method.score: Weighted multi-factor score: multi-timeframe trend alignment (25%), confirmed daily/weekly/monthly market structure (40%), volume-price pressure (15%), 20/55-bar breakout structure (10%), trend efficiency (5%) and ATR/price volatility quality (5%). Missing dimensions are excluded and remaining weights renormalized. This is a screening heuristic, not a validated forecast.
method.ranking_score: Provisional technical rank = 70% risk-adjusted multi-factor score + 30% cross-sectional relative momentum score. The relative score uses percentiles: 30% 6-period monthly return, 25% 13-period weekly return, 25% 60-period daily return, 10% 20-period daily return and 10% latest volume / 20-session average; missing measures are excluded and available weights are renormalized. The composite prioritizes confirmed structure and volume-price behavior over indicator count.
method.sort_order: Technical rank score descending; then risk-adjusted checklist, relative momentum and longer-period momentum.
method.risk_adjustment: Experimental heat penalty subtracted from technical score; ranked by adjusted score
method.eligibility: At least 200 daily, 26 weekly and 12 monthly candles, with latest daily data no more than 10 days old

warning: Technical screening only, not a buy/sell recommendation. A separate historical walk-forward report at data/radar_validation.json recomputes the same rank at 12 past cutoffs and tests 20/60/120-session price returns. Interpret relative outperformance together with absolute returns and win rate; it is not proof of profitability. Dividends, transaction costs, slippage, delisting survivors and corporate-action adjustment quality remain limitations. Fundamental health, earnings quality and project ROI are not part of this technical-only score; full TSE/IFB coverage has not been independently verified.
